items.title: Why Iambic’s CEO believes preclinical cancer therapy could be ‘holy grail’ for CDK inhibitors
items.desc: Fresh off a $150 million IPO, Iambic Therapeutics has unveiled preclinical data for a potential challenger in one of oncology's most competitive drug classes: cyclin-dependent kinases.

items.title: Sanofi inks massive $41B Insmed buyout for post-Dupixent growth drivers
items.desc: Sanofi has struck a deal to acquire Insmed for $41 billion, securing three commercial and late-phase respiratory assets to offset Dupixent’s looming loss of exclusivity.

items.title: Led by founders of J&J-acquired Intra-Cellular, Ritzey debuts with $112M for DYRK1A inhibitors
items.desc: The founder of Intra-Cellular Therapies, which was bought by Johnson & Johnson last year for $14.6 billion, is jumping back into the biotech fray with a new company similarly aimed at signaling pathways in the brain.

items.title: Lilly buys preclinical LoQus23 in $725M deal to zero in on Huntington’s target
items.desc: Eli Lilly has struck a deal to buy preclinical Huntington’s disease biotech LoQus23 Therapeutics for up to $725 million.

items.title: Sanofi to buy Insmed for $41B in industry's largest acquisition in years
